name: Daily sales volume
description: Units sold per SKU per day, rolled up to category and store cluster. Source: OMS order lines.

name: Historical price changes
description: Price and promotional price changes per SKU with effective dates. Source: PIM.

name: Supplier on-time delivery %
description: Rolling 13-week share of PO lines delivered on or before the promised date, per supplier. Source: PO history.

name: Local weather events
description: Severe weather flags by UK region and day (storm, snow, heatwave) for store demand. Source: external weather feed.

name: Weather events at origin ports and factory regions
description: Typhoon, storm and flood event flags by port or factory region and day, with severity. Source: external weather feed; not yet used in production.

name: Customer tenure and RFM
description: Customer tenure, recency, frequency and monetary scores. Source: CRM.

name: Carrier delivery consistency
description: Carrier on-time rate and variance of transit days per lane. Source: YMS gate and trailer events.

name: Port delay indicators
description: Daily vessel waiting days and berth delay per port. Source: external port feed.

name: DC inventory by site
description: Closing stock units per SKU per DC. Source: WMS.

name: Competitor price intelligence
description: Competitor shelf prices matched to our SKUs. Source: external price intelligence feed.

name: Planned promotions
description: Promotion start and end dates, mechanic and depth per SKU. Source: merchandising calendar.

name: Ocean transit times by lane
description: Actual port-to-port transit days per shipment and lane. Source: Track & Trace.

name: Carrier ETA vs actual variance
description: Difference between carrier-quoted ETA and actual arrival per lane, with ETA revision count. Source: carrier portal.

name: PO line characteristics and outcomes
description: Order value, lead time, quantity, revisions and delivered-late outcome per PO. Source: PO system.

name: ASN submission and delivery timing
description: Hours between ASN submission and promised ship date, and ASN vs actual receipt. Source: WMS.

name: Supplier quality and delivery metrics
description: Monthly supplier scorecard: quality, delivery, responsiveness scores. Source: SRM.

name: Payment terms and history by supplier
description: Payment terms, days-to-pay and late-payment counts per supplier. Source: GL.
